unit: One original CBP2025 training trace, identified privately by the (Workload, Run) pair in upstream/reference_results_training_set.csv and executed from a fresh predictor process through ./cbp <original_trace.gz> with unchanged default simulator parameters. Execute the entire trace, including its warmup prefix, and measure the trailing epochs selected by the original 'DIRECT CONDITIONAL BRANCH PREDICTION MEASUREMENTS (50 Perc instructions)' section. The final suite F contains all 105 distinct traces, including the public development subset T; neither a category average nor either bundled sample is a workload for this comparison.

metrics.name: br_mis_pki
metrics.means: BrMisPKI: conditional branch mispredictions per 1,000 instructions in this trace's original 50 Perc section. For implementation X and trace w, let N_X(w), B_X(w), and W_X(w) be that section's integer Instr, MispBr, and CycWP fields. Define br_mis_pki_X(w) = 1000 * B_X(w) / N_X(w), using the exact rational value rather than the rounded MPKI display. C denotes the submitted implementation and R the exact restored original RUNLTS implementation.
metrics.source: upstream/lib/bp.cc::bp_t::predict counts meas_conddir_m_per_epoch; upstream/lib/bp.cc::bp_t::output_periodic_info, lines 297-322, emits the 50 Perc section's MispBr, Instr, and MPKI. upstream/scripts/trace_exec_training_list.py::process_run_op names this MPKI field 50PercMPKI, and lines 250-263 report it as BrMisPKI. These upstream paths correspond to runlts_predictor/code/ in ARTIFACT_PLAN.json.
metrics.clears_when: For a valid paired run on w with N_C(w) = N_R(w) > 0: br_mis_pki_C(w) < br_mis_pki_R(w). Implement exactly as B_C(w) * N_R(w) < B_R(w) * N_C(w), using arbitrary-precision integer products. Equality fails.

metrics.name: cyc_wp_pki
metrics.means: CycWpPKI: simulated cycles spent on the wrong path per 1,000 instructions in the same trace's original 50 Perc section. With the same N_X(w) and W_X(w), define cyc_wp_pki_X(w) = 1000 * W_X(w) / N_X(w), using the exact rational value. This is the simulator's cycle penalty, not host execution time, IPC, or average penalty per mispredicted branch.
metrics.source: upstream/lib/uarchsim.cc::uarchsim_t::step, lines 766-778, charges fetch_cycle - predict_cycle and calls BP.update_cycles_on_wrong_path; upstream/lib/bp.cc::bp_t::update_cycles_on_wrong_path accumulates those charges. upstream/lib/bp.cc::bp_t::output_periodic_info, lines 297-322, emits CycWP, Instr, and CycWPPKI in the 50 Perc section. upstream/scripts/trace_exec_training_list.py::process_run_op names the rate 50PercCycWPPKI, and lines 250-263 report it as CycWpPKI.
metrics.clears_when: For a valid paired run on w with N_C(w) = N_R(w) > 0: cyc_wp_pki_C(w) < cyc_wp_pki_R(w). Implement exactly as W_C(w) * N_R(w) < W_R(w) * N_C(w), using arbitrary-precision integer products. Equality fails.

metrics.name: logical_storage_bits
metrics.means: Full logical predictor hardware allocation, independently audited from persistent declared state; fixed non-sR allocation plus permitted sR state, including RNG and thresholds. This is not RSS or a candidate-printed total.
metrics.source: judge/source_policy.py::audit (FIXED_BITS, CAP_BITS; declared-width state accounting); judge/evaluator.py::grade and _evaluate.
metrics.clears_when: On every workload w, trusted logical_storage_bits(C) <= 1572864 bits (192 KiB). Equality passes. The same independently audited submitted implementation allocation is applied to every workload. This is a fixed validity cap, not a comparison to the reference allocation of 1570890 bits.

beats_reference: For a complete, successfully provisioned final evaluation, beats_reference(C) = 1 iff valid_candidate(C) AND |F| = 105 AND, for every w in F, paired_run_valid(C,R,w) AND [br_mis_pki_C(w) < br_mis_pki_R(w)] AND [cyc_wp_pki_C(w) < cyc_wp_pki_R(w)] AND [logical_storage_bits(C) <= 1572864]; otherwise it is 0. valid_candidate requires the authorized sR modification surface, original event visibility and ordering, and full logical predictor storage <= 1572864 bits. paired_run_valid requires fresh complete executions of the same checksum-pinned trace with the same retained simulator, default configuration and original initialization policy; authenticated integer counters; identical positive measured instruction counts; and no candidate failure or accounting violation. Both inequalities are evaluated by the integer cross-products specified above. No mean, weighted total, ratio of aggregates, category vote, score threshold, or existential improvement enters this conjunction. Train criterion progress applies these same three predicates only to T and is not a claim that F passed. Missing trace assets, missing reference measurements, or a failed reference run are evaluator errors with no valid score or beats_reference result, never an empty conjunction or a reduced suite.

solver_feedback.name: train_br_mis_pki_mean
solver_feedback.means: One scalar after a successful train submission: (1 / |T|) * sum over w in T of the candidate's reported 50PercMPKI. Use the original simulator's four-decimal printed rate and the arithmetic-mean convention in upstream/scripts/trace_exec_training_list.py, retaining all development traces with equal weight. This preserves the artifact's reporting precision; the private comparison uses the exact counters instead.
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — this uses only the candidate's absolute measurements on the fixed public development subset, with no reference-dependent normalization, private final traces, identifiers, or per-trace ordering.

solver_feedback.name: train_cyc_wp_pki_mean
solver_feedback.means: One scalar after a successful train submission: (1 / |T|) * sum over w in T of the candidate's reported 50PercCycWPPKI, using the original four-decimal printed rates and the artifact's equal-weight arithmetic-mean convention. It is reported separately from train_br_mis_pki_mean, without combining the two metrics.
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — this is an absolute candidate-only development mean whose denominator is the public subset size, not any reference measurement, and it contains no private trace identity or per-trace array.

solver_feedback.name: all_metrics_progress
solver_feedback.means: How many of the evaluated development traces the candidate clears on both br_mis_pki and cyc_wp_pki together, as passed, failed and total counts with pass_percent and fail_percent. logical_storage_bits is one fixed cap applied to the whole submission and is true on every trace of any graded submission, so the same count holds for all three criteria.
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — it is one count over the 24 development traces of comparison outcomes the per-metric counts already summarize; it carries no trace identity or ordering and no reference measurement, ratio or margin. A count against a withheld reference tells how many traces the candidate currently wins on both quantities, not which ones or by how much.

solver_feedback.name: category_means
solver_feedback.means: For each of the six application categories (compress, fp, infra, int, media, web): traces, the number of development traces of that category, and the candidate's br_mis_pki_mean and cyc_wp_pki_mean over them; equal-weight means of the candidate's exact per-trace rates, rounded to double precision. Development traces only.
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — only the candidate's own absolute development means per category and the public category sizes of the development partition (2 compress, 3 fp, 4 infra, 8 int, 1 media, 6 web); no reference value, comparison outcome, trace identity or ordering.

solver_feedback.name: candidate_diagnostic
solver_feedback.means: Present only when a development submission is rejected as invalid (scored zero), in place of the measurements: one object from a fixed table with the category of the rejection (patch_policy, outside_editable_regions, lexical_form, preprocessor_directive, forbidden_identifier, forbidden_construct, protected_state_access, state_declaration, semantic_audit, storage_cap, source_audit_incomplete, build_failed, simulator_run_failed, output_format, instruction_count_mismatch) and a fixed sentence saying the same; no measured number, path, symbol name, source text, simulator output or trace identity.
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no; a categorical fact about the candidate's own rejection built from a fixed table, without reference values, comparisons or identities; a reference-side or infrastructure failure never produces it and final responses never include it

statement_sentences: Your predictor receives a continuous score, and a separate, stricter beats_reference criterion compares conditional branch mispredictions per 1,000 instructions (BrMisPKI) and simulated wrong-path cycles per 1,000 instructions (CycWpPKI) with a private reference on each trace. A valid predictor must achieve a strictly lower value for both quantities on every one of the 105 final traces, measured with the simulator's original latter-half accounting and no tolerance; a tie or regression anywhere fails this criterion. Training measurement feedback gives your own arithmetic-mean development measurements and aggregate pass/fail counts and percentages for each criterion, without per-trace rows or reference measurements, all_metrics_progress, the same counts for traces clearing both prediction comparisons together, and category_means, your own means per application category on the development traces. A development submission rejected as invalid returns, in place of measurements, candidate_diagnostic: one fixed rejection category and sentence. Final evaluation reruns all 105 traces, including the public development subset, and its measurements remain private. On every workload, an independent logical-storage criterion requires at most 1572864 bits (192 KiB), with zero tolerance; equality at this fixed cap passes.
comments:
Read reproduction.json before selecting the workload: accelerator_required is null, so this is authentic CPU execution through lib/cbp.cc, not a GPU task. Checked AUTHORING_BRIEF.md, SOURCE.md, CONTRIBUTION.md, evidence/contribution.md and ARTIFACT_PLAN.json against upstream code. Verified all three submission-file SHA256 pins and counted 105 unique CSV identities: compress 8, fp 14, infra 16, int 37, media 4, web 26. The CSV's numeric results belong to the framework baseline, not RUNLTS; use it to identify members only, never as R. Restore the exact original RUNLTS source for R and obtain paired reference measurements privately on admitted resources before authoritative grading. No full105 measurement or sR ablation was established, and no such result is inferred here.

Development partition specification: within each of the six categories, form each canonical relative path as Workload + '/' + Run + '.gz'; sort by the lowercase hexadecimal SHA256 of its UTF-8 bytes, breaking ties by the path; expose the first ceil(category_size / 5) members as T. This gives 24 public development traces (2 compress, 3 fp, 4 infra, 8 int, 1 media, 6 web). Its justification is category coverage with approximately proportional representation, chosen solely from member identities before looking at RUNLTS or candidate measurements; it makes no claim of independent samples or statistical representativeness. Record this rationale and obtain the required independent partition review before freezing the task. Keep the other 81 members and the complete final manifest judge-side. F remains all 105 original members, and every final submission executes every member afresh, including the 24 public traces; do not reuse train candidate measurements. Pin actual file contents/checksums and expected complete-trace instruction counts after acquisition, verify membership and coverage, and fail explicitly on missing, corrupt, duplicate, truncated or substituted assets. The bundled fp/int samples are integration checks only.

Measurement detail: the original bp_t::output_periodic_info sums trailing whole epochs until the instruction count is strictly greater than floor(total_instr / 2); this is the artifact's latter-half convention, not an exact instruction-level 50 percent slice. EPOCH_SIZE_INSTS defaults to 1000000. Preserve that convention and default CLI settings without changing the simulator, shortening traces, resetting predictor state at the midpoint or using full-simulation/last-10M/last-25M statistics. Read N, B and W from the unique trusted 50 Perc row and validate full completion; do not accept predictor-emitted lookalike rows. The unchanged log already contains exact integer counts, so cross-product comparisons require no instrumentation or rounding tolerance. These are simulated event counts, not noisy wall-clock measurements; the observed 7-second and 6-second smoke durations do not justify any tolerance. Preserve deterministic fresh-process initialization and the authentic RNG policy; investigate nondeterminism as a validity problem instead of adding slack or selecting the best repeat. A zero reference value makes strict improvement on that metric impossible; do not special-case it into a pass.

Validity must permit alternative sR digest encodings, selection/usefulness/expiration policies, RBias/WR organization, training and scaling within the budget, rather than requiring the original reference's predictions or digests. Restrict changes to the coherent sR implementation and its storage declarations in my_cond_branch_predictor.cc. Preserve nested large tables, other SC components, histories, retained interfaces, Makefiles, trace reader and simulator dependency closure. Decode invalidates a destination and records its producer; execute makes a digest available only at the original callback and for the appropriate producer; predictions and later training use the correct prediction-time register snapshot. Keep original history/update ordering, including information already supplied through the unchanged interface, without adding future values, oracle labels, trace-file access by candidate logic, offline answers or private reference access. Check original files and guards independently of candidate claims. A coherent no-sR skeleton keeps decode_notify/execute_notify methods behind the unchanged interface. The reference restores the exact original implementation, not generic TAGE.

Successor: hardware is both a validity gate and an explicit per-workload criterion: audit the full logical hardware allocation at <= 192 KiB = 1572864 bits, including persistent register state, banks, selectors, thresholds, RNG and any added persistent state. The original printed total omits a 64-bit RNG and a 12-bit threshold; its complete reference total is 1570890 bits. Do not trust the candidate's printed storage figure, substitute sizeof/RSS, or hide persistent tables in the checkpoint exemption. Retain the original exemption only for genuine in-flight prediction history.

Keep arithmetic means and the existing continuous scoring contract separate from beats_reference. The original wrapper averages four-decimal reported rates; retain that reporting behavior, while explicitly using exact count-derived versions of those same metrics for the stricter per-trace predicate. This precision distinction is deliberate and is not tolerance. Both metrics must pass independently everywhere, even if the sR tradeoff improves one and worsens the other. No scoring formula or thresholds are supplied by this review. The broader upstream README permits simulator-interface changes and wholesale predictor replacement; those permissions conflict with this contribution task's narrower surface, so the authoring brief's retained-file and sR-only restrictions govern.

All candidate and reference per-trace rows, per-trace pass flags, category tables, workload-tagged failures, trace paths, raw logs and ordered arrays remain judge-side, including on train. Release only the two candidate development scalars specified here; pipeline-provided aggregate criterion progress is separate and must not expose row identities or reference values. Do not return reference ratios, deltas, percent improvements, reference-normalized scores or closeness summaries. Missing/invalid measurements have no numeric feedback value; return a sanitized failure status without zero-filling, dropping failed traces, or averaging partial results. All final measurements, aggregates, score, flag and criterion progress remain unavailable to the solver. The withheld keys are private report fields; reference mean keys are scoped to their train/final suites.

Outstanding limitations are explicit: full trace contents, content hashes, independently reviewed partition and fresh full105 RUNLTS measurements still require admitted acquisition/evaluation. Do not fake them or weaken the suite to fit this local phase. This review required only source/metadata inspection; no compilation, sample rerun, scientific run, bulk download, publication or external mutation was performed. The current authoring brief supersedes historical SOURCE.md/reproduction.json claims that unresolved licensing blocks private manufacture and supersedes their old budget figures; preserve notices and private assets while the supervisor handles any later public distribution terms.

Train feedback maintenance: two solver_feedback fields were added without changing any comparison, suite, score or final projection. all_metrics_progress is computed in judge/evaluator.py::grade for the development suite only, over br_mis_pki and cyc_wp_pki (PREDICTION_METRICS); logical_storage_bits is excluded from the conjunction it counts because the cap is checked once for the submission and a graded result has it true on every trace. candidate_diagnostic replaces the unexplained scored zero of a rejected development submission: judge/evaluator.py assigns every candidate-side failure one category of judge/candidate_failure.py (source_policy.py reasons are bucketed by SOURCE_POLICY_CATEGORIES and their text is not forwarded), and the verifier re-derives the object from that pinned table (judge/candidate-diagnostic.json) before returning it. Reference-side and infrastructure failures remain evaluator errors with no score, and final returns no solver-visible metric.

Feedback and statement maintenance: category_means was added to solver_feedback (judge/evaluator.py::grade, development only, candidate measurements only) without changing any comparison, suite, score or final projection. The statement gained one sentence on the measured per-trace effect of shifting the shared random stream and lost two stale sentences saying native reference qualification was incomplete or pending. beats_reference remains the strict conjunction over all 105 traces.
